claims.statement: Tom Allen began going to the races at the Fair Grounds in St. Louis after seeing the Derby run there on Saturday, June 26, 1897.
claims.excerpt: For the first time this season he went to the track last Saturday to see the Derby run, and he fell in love with the game.

claims.statement: Tom Allen beat Mike McCoole in a fight (date and place not given).
claims.excerpt: the conqueror of Mike McCool has confined his operations to things that can talk.
